_comment: Config for tools/poll_surfaces.py (weekly E1-E6 high-signal poller, refresh-protocol.md E-tier). Public: only URLs, channel handles, and numeric thresholds. Tune thresholds after 2-3 rounds of real inbox review (calibrate E3 trendingScore + E4 WoW to your noise tolerance).

E1._note: PulseMCP keyless directory API (the newsletter feed.xml is Cloudflare-walled). The v0beta endpoint needs a BROWSER user_agent (tool UAs get rate-limited/410). No created-date field -> 'what's new' = dedup vs inbox over weeks; traction filter (stars OR downloads) keeps it to notable servers.

E3._note: HF returns sorted by trendingScore; limit caps the fetch. min_trending_score=40 chosen from round-1 distribution [127,125,107,68,65,54,47,43,43,38,38,35,34,32,31,30,30,28,28,28] — natural break ~40 keeps ~top 9, cuts the 28-38 tail. Re-tune as the distribution shifts (scores are relative).

E4._note: npm WoW-velocity watchlist (verification surface). Add candidate packages here as they show up in other surfaces; downloads beat stars for anti-fake signal.

E5._note: Weekly poll catches Show HN 24-72h old, before posts accumulate 30 pts. Lowered to 15pts OR 5 comments to catch launches early — the monthly sweep re-verifies, so over-including at the weekly discovery stage is fine.
E5.query: mcp OR agent OR scraper OR skill

E6._note: AI early-demo channels. ucid left blank -> resolved at runtime from handle and can be pasted back here once known (first-run resolution, per protocol).
